title: Employee Warning Notice - legacy standardized disciplinary form
summary: Seven restricted disciplinary case documents in the correspondence archive use the same standardized Employee Warning Notice form. The reusable template structure can be modeled safely without retaining employee-specific case facts.

claims.claim: The standardized form contains Employee Information fields for employee name, employee ID, date, job title, manager and department.

evidence.note: Employee values are excluded; only repeated form structure is generalized.

claims.claim: The form provides warning-level choices including Counseling, Verbal Warning, First Warning, Second Warning, Third Warning, Fourth Warning and, in some versions, additional numbered warnings.

evidence.page_or_section: Employee Warning Notice repeated template structure

claims.claim: The form provides offense-category choices for tardiness/leaving early, absenteeism, violation of company policies, substandard work, violation of safety rules, rudeness to customers/coworkers, and Other.

evidence.note: Categories are template options and do not establish frequency of actual offenses.

claims.claim: The form includes sections for details/description of infraction, consequences of further infractions, employee comments, department-manager approval, HR approval, employee signature and date.

evidence.page_or_section: Employee Warning Notice repeated template structure

claims.claim: The acknowledgment language states that signing confirms understanding/receipt and discussion of the warning and improvement plan, but does not necessarily mean the employee agrees with the warning.

evidence.page_or_section: Acknowledgement of Receipt of Warning boilerplate
evidence.note: Boilerplate appears in all seven standardized warning forms reviewed.

steps: Identify warning level and offense category.
Document the infraction and improvement/corrective expectations.
Document consequences of further infractions where applicable.
Obtain management/HR approval and employee acknowledgment/signature.
decisions: Whether additional corrective action or escalation is warranted.
exceptions: Employee signature does not necessarily indicate agreement with the warning.
controls: Do not infer selected offense categories from blank template choices.
Current form/version and approval roles require validation before operational use.
unresolved_questions: What form currently replaces or succeeds this legacy Employee Warning Notice?
Were all numbered warning levels formally defined, or could managers use the form flexibly?
Which roles must sign/approve the current disciplinary form?
automation_candidates: Add a deterministic scanner fingerprint for the Employee Warning Notice title, section headings and offense grid.
Extract warning level, offense category, dates and signatures into a restricted audit record while keeping narrative case content out of generalized knowledge.

provenance.notes: Only repeated template structure and boilerplate were generalized; employee-level facts remain restricted.
